towns.name: Fiun Outpost
towns.summary: Fiun Outpost (95.9N 56.8W) is the last flicker of the Fiun, the magic-users whose attempt to create life made the Eater; a mysterious portal brought the few survivors to the Halaetan Isles. It lies on the north shore of icy Vanguard Isle: a narrow frozen shore (z 0-2) between the open Arctic sea and a sheer ice wall rising 100 m to the south. Two three-storey timber Sho-style towers with tapered roofs and smoking chimneys (13 m) hold the blacksmith, archmage and shopkeeper; the Life Stone stands on the sea ice at the water's edge; the augmentation trainers (Fiun Bayaas, Luunere, Noress, Riish, Ruun, Vasherr) gather round a smouldering brazier south-west of the drop; ice-crystal clusters and snow-capped rocks dot the flats, and 140 m east a stone hut guards the Portal to Silyun.
